postReview.title: Coventry City 3-2 Crystal Palace: Late own goal condemns Frank to losing start
postReview.description: Crystal Palace suffered a fifth consecutive Premier League defeat in Thomas Frank's first game in charge against Coventry City.

postReview.title: Coventry City 3-2 Crystal Palace: un autogol tardío condena a Frank a una derrota en su debut
postReview.description: El Crystal Palace sufrió ante el Coventry City su quinta derrota consecutiva en la Premier League en el debut de Thomas Frank como entrenador.

postReview.title: Coventry City-Crystal Palace 3-2: un autogol nel finale rovina l'esordio di Frank
postReview.description: Il Crystal Palace ha incassato la quinta sconfitta consecutiva in Premier League, perdendo contro il Coventry City all'esordio di Thomas Frank in panchina.

postReview.title: Coventry City 3 x 2 Crystal Palace: gol contra no fim faz Frank perder na estreia
postReview.description: Crystal Palace chega à quinta derrota seguida na Premier League ao perder para o Coventry City na estreia de Thomas Frank.

postReview.title: Coventry City 3-2 Crystal Palace : un but contre son camp en fin de match condamne Frank à la défaite pour ses débuts
postReview.description: Crystal Palace a subi une cinquième défaite consécutive en Premier League face à Coventry City pour la première de Thomas Frank sur le banc.

postReview.title: Coventry City 3:2 Crystal Palace: Spätes Eigentor beschert Frank Niederlage beim Einstand
postReview.description: Crystal Palace kassierte bei Thomas Franks Einstand gegen Coventry City die fünfte Premier-League-Niederlage in Serie.

postReview.title: كوفنتري سيتي 3-2 كريستال بالاس: هدف ذاتي متأخر يفسد بداية فرانك

postReview.title: Coventry City 3-2 Crystal Palace: autogolo tardio dita derrota de Frank na estreia
postReview.description: O Crystal Palace sofreu a quinta derrota consecutiva na Premier League, no primeiro jogo de Thomas Frank ao comando, diante do Coventry City.
